description.value:
Your entire passage through the universe is guided by paths you never took; and those unturned stones are lost to the flows of time – until you learned how to take that potential into action.

When you take this feat, you create a special card that you keep on your person. This card keeps track of minor and major decisions you take in lieu of another, which results in it being a record of choices you avoided. The GM ultimately is the final determinant of what is a minor or major decision for you, but typically a minor decision is picking a skill to overcome an obstacle in your journey, while a major decision is deciding on a course of action, which could include fighting an enemy or choosing to seek peace, or to take one adventure over another.

The card becomes empowered with the potential of the things you did not do once the card has recorded at least a week’s worth of minor and major decisions, though the GM might rule enough adventuring or a very significant decision would be enough to meet this sooner. Once empowered, you or a creature you pass this card to can Invest it like a magic item and gain the Cascade Potential action. If the holder uses this action, dies while they have the card invested, if you die, or if you spend a ten minute ritual to Dismiss the card, the card vanishes, and the holder cannot invest another card from this feat for 1 month. You can only make one of these cards at a time until the card vanishes.
